name: Subway Tile
description: Glazed subway tiles in running bond, bottle greens and ivories with a gloss along each top edge and a shade along each foot.

code.style: --rule: ( @random(${shapeFrequency}) { :before { content: ''; position: absolute; left: 2%; top: 2%; width: 96%; height: 46%; background: linear-gradient(180deg, var(--color6) 0, transparent 34% 70%, var(--color1) 100%), @p(var(--color2), var(--color3), var(--color4), var(--color5)); -webkit-transition: ease 450ms; transition: ease 450ms; } :after { content: ''; position: absolute; left: -48%; top: 52%; width: 196%; height: 46%; background: linear-gradient(180deg, var(--color6) 0, transparent 34% 70%, var(--color1) 100%), @p(var(--color2), var(--color3), var(--color4), var(--color5)); -webkit-mask: @var(--sj); mask: @var(--sj); -webkit-transition: ease 450ms; transition: ease 450ms; } } -webkit-transition: ease 450ms; transition: ease 450ms; );
code.doodle: :doodle { @grid: ${grid}; @size: ${width} ${height}; overflow:hidden; text-align:center; box-sizing:border-box; --sj: linear-gradient(90deg, #000 48.98%, transparent 48.98% 51.02%, #000 51.02%); } :container { background: var(--color0); overflow:hidden; }
